claims.evidence: paper 2.8–2.9: DTT reduction, iodoacetamide alkylation, trypsin, 10 ppm / 0.02 Da, two missed cleavages; PeptideGroups modifications: Carbamidomethyl [C] 2283, Oxidation [M] 767, Acetyl [N-Term] 17

limitations: The run → F-number assignment inside Proteome Discoverer is not written in any deposited file. F1 = HFX1_FPEP210040125-1A is supported by the export file name; F2–F6 = 126–130 assumes PD's default input order (by file name). The group labels per F column are exact (Table S1).

The tumours are human MDA PCa 2b xenografts in nude mice; the sEVs are a mixture of mouse prostate and human tumour origin. The search was against a mouse database (Mus musculus accessions in the export), so organism is Mus musculus; the xenograft is recorded in characteristics[treatment].
Age 11W is derived (implanted at 7 weeks, harvested 4 weeks later).
Whether carbamidomethylation was searched as fixed is not stated; it is present on all Cys-containing peptides in the export and is annotated as fixed.
